name: Stop Sign
desc: A wide swing. The machine in front takes {dmg}. Everyone else in the swing takes 22% of that, with a {chance}% chance to stun.

name: Hurl
desc: Throw scrap that passes through enemies for {dmg} damage.

name: Iron Hide
desc: Passive. +{armor}% armor and +{life}% life.

name: Turnstile
desc: Spin. The nearest machine takes {dmg}. Everyone else in the spin takes 22% of that.

name: Picket Rush
desc: Rush forward, untouchable, hitting each enemy in the path for {dmg}.

name: War Horn
desc: Stun enemies around you for {sec}s and gain +60% armor for 8s.

name: Overtime
desc: For {sec}s: +40% attack speed and {leech}% life stolen per hit.

name: Earthbreaker
desc: Leap to the nearest enemy and slam for {dmg}. Anyone else in the slam takes 22% of that.

name: Solidarity
desc: Passive. +{damage}% damage for each enemy near you, up to five.

name: Lunch Pail
desc: Set it down. You and anyone fighting beside it recover {regen}% of their life each second from the pail, until its stores ({stores}% of your life) run out.

name: Seniority
desc: Passive. The damage type on the weapon in your hand gains +{bonus}%.

name: Hold the Line
desc: Passive. Each second you have not dashed adds {armor} armour and 5% damage reduction, up to six seconds. A dash spends it.

name: Call the Strike
desc: A horn. Ordinary machines are pushed back. Elites and bosses are pulled in. Everyone caught takes {dmg} noise.

name: Two-Handed
desc: Your next three swings are slow, cannot be interrupted, and hit a wider arc.

name: Last Shift
desc: For {sec}s your swings leech {leech}% and you do not flinch. If you fall while it is up, you fall.

name: Arc Chain
desc: Lightning that leaps through {enemies} enemies for {dmg} each. For {ward}s after you cast it, {paid}% of each hit is paid from energy, and only as much as you have.

name: Spark Lance
desc: A bolt that pierces every enemy in a line for {dmg}. Primes your next Arc Chain within 3 seconds for +30%.

name: Cipher Ward
desc: Passive. {drain}% of damage taken drains energy instead of life.

name: Null Nova
desc: A blast around you: {dmg} damage and {sec}s stun.

name: Watchdog
desc: Deploy a turret for {sec}s that fires for {dmg} per shot.

name: Overclock
desc: Passive. +{energy} energy per second and {faster}% faster skill recovery.

name: Black Storm
desc: Call a storm on a spot for 4s. Shards fall there, and each strike deals {dmg}.

name: Botnet
desc: Hijack three drones for {sec}s. Each bite deals {dmg}.

name: Zero Day
desc: Passive. +{deadly}% deadly strike chance, and deadly strikes deal {dmg}.

name: Ground Fault
desc: A line of heat on the floor for {sec}s, {dmg} every half second. Casting it locks your hands for a moment.

name: Packet Storm
desc: Mark a spot. A noise storm arrives there after a short delay and strikes for {dmg}. Walking away does not move it.

name: Schema
desc: Passive. You work in one element{element}. Damage of that type gains +{bonus}%. The other two do not. Sister Null can make you choose again. Dying cannot.

name: Step Back
desc: About four paces back along your facing.

name: Patched
desc: Passive. {barrier}% of the Surge damage you deal becomes a barrier, up to {cap}% of your life. Nothing, if your Schema is Heat or Noise.

name: Kill Dash Nine
desc: One machine, for {dmg} of your Schema element. It ignores that element's resistance, once. A resistance of zero is still a wall. Casting it locks your hands.

name: Scatter Shot
desc: Throw a fan of {blades} blades for {dmg} each. Anything within arm’s reach is also cut for {dmg2}.

name: Fleet Step
desc: Dash, untouchable, then run 50% faster for {sec}s.

name: Evasion
desc: Passive. +{speed}% run speed and {dodge}% chance to avoid any hit.

name: Lure
desc: Drop a decoy parcel. Machines attack it, then it bursts for {dmg}.

name: Tack Strip
desc: Scatter spikes for 6s that slow enemies and deal {dmg} twice a second.

name: Scavenger
desc: Passive. +{credits}% credits and +{mf}% magic find.

name: Rush Order
desc: A 1.5s stream of blades at the nearest enemy, {dmg} each.

name: Signed For
desc: Strike the nearest enemy for {dmg}. It takes +30% damage for 8s.

name: Deadeye
desc: Passive. {chance}% chance for throws to pierce and +{deadly}% deadly strike.

name: Return to Sender
desc: A throw that goes out and comes back, {dmg} on each pass.

name: Route Knowledge
desc: Passive. After a dash, you avoid {dodge}% more hits for {sec}s. Standing still does nothing.

name: Second Drop
desc: One decoy copies your last throw, then stays on a 4.5-pace leash for 6s. Leave it behind and it pops.

name: Manifest
desc: A piercing throw for {dmg} that splits into two after the first machine it hits.

name: Hazard Pay
desc: Passive. A throw that kills pays {pay} extra credits and finds gear as if you had +{mf}% magic find. A dash does not pay.

name: Missed Connection
desc: Mark a machine. If it dies within {sec}s, to you or to anyone with you, you appear where it fell and your next throw costs nothing.

name: Honeypot
desc: Plant a lure. Machines swarm it for 3s, then it bursts for {dmg} and stuns.

name: Proxy Hop
desc: Appear behind the nearest machine and stab for {dmg}, always a deadly strike.

name: OpSec
desc: Passive. {chance}% chance to avoid any hit and +{deadly}% deadly strike.

name: Logic Bomb
desc: Lay a mine that blows for {dmg} when a machine steps near. Up to four.

name: Incognito
desc: Vanish for {sec}s. Machines forget you. Your next blow deals {dmg}.

name: Dox
desc: Expose a machine and everything near it: +30% damage taken for {sec}s, and {dmg} now.

name: Zip Bomb
desc: One blast of {dmg} that unpacks into five more of {dmg2}.

name: Sockpuppet
calc: copies=L>=5?'Two copies':'A copy'; plural=L>=5?'':'s'; sec=10+L; dmg=pct(.5+.08*L)
desc: {copies} of you fight{plural} for {sec}s, dealing {dmg} and drawing fire.

name: Legion
desc: A dozen unseen blades strike across the screen for {dmg} each.

name: Rehearsal
desc: A strike for {dmg}. Another within 3s adds a charge, up to three.

name: The Dump
desc: Spend every charge. One is a rust bleed. Two is a silence. Three is a screen of blades for {dmg}. A plain attack spends one charge and bleeds. Charges do not survive a zone change.

name: No Attribution
desc: Passive. While Incognito is up, laying a mine does not break it, and the mine arms faster. Nothing, while you can be seen.

name: Dead Drop
desc: Place a mark. Activate again to appear there. One mark. It does not explode.

name: Cutout
desc: Passive. The first hit that would destroy a mine or a sockpuppet is ignored. It does not apply to you.

name: We Were Never Here
desc: Every mine and sockpuppet goes off as a silence, and you drop into Incognito. If you have none, nothing happens.

name: Interns
desc: Summon an intern that fights for {dmg}. You keep up to {most}. They follow you everywhere, step in front of a blow, and each one alive cuts the damage you take by 5%, up to 20%.

name: Cease & Desist
desc: Bind every machine in an area for {sec}s and deal {dmg}.

name: Equity
desc: Passive. Your workforce deals +{damage}% damage and you gain +{life}% life.

name: Contractors
desc: Summon a drone that shoots for {dmg}. You keep up to {most}.

name: Crunch
desc: For {sec}s your workforce attacks 60% faster and hits 30% harder.

name: Mech Suit
desc: For {sec}s: double armor, and your attacks become slams of {dmg}. Heals you 30% of your life.

name: Chief of Staff
desc: Summon one hulking enforcer that machines attack first. It hits for {dmg} in an arc.

name: Acqui-hire
calc: sec=12+2*L; champions=L>=5?' Champions too.':' Champions resist until rank 5.'
desc: Turn the nearest machine to your side for {sec}s.{champions}

name: Layoffs
desc: Every summoned worker explodes for {dmg}. Each one heals you 5%.

name: Garden Leave
desc: Requires a worker or a converted machine killed in the last 4s. Curse whatever killed them: {dmg} a second for {sec}s, and they cannot be healed. With no body, nothing happens.

name: Non-Compete
desc: One machine can attack only you for {sec}s. Your workforce will not hit it.

name: Vesting
desc: Passive. A worker gains a stack every 3s it stays alive. Each stack is +{damage}% damage. Summoning over them, or laying them off, takes every stack.

name: Term Sheet
desc: One officer. You may feed it a weapon from your pack. The weapon is consumed, and the officer strikes with that damage type for {dmg}. Empty-handed, it is weaker and it is Impact.

name: Org Debt
desc: Passive. Each worker on the field cuts the damage you deal by {yours}% and raises theirs by {theirs}%. It stacks. Swing it yourself with a full headcount and you are playing this class wrong.

name: Liquidation
desc: Enemy corpses within 5 paces explode for {dmg}. Your staff does not. Layoffs is the button that spends them.

name: Cold Frame
desc: A rust patch with a 2.2-pace radius for 6 seconds. It slows, and deals {dmg} every half second. It ends if you enter a chassis. While you have a plot down you take 12% less, and 4% less for each further plot, up to 28%.

name: Wear the Hound
desc: Become the hound: faster, melee, less armour. Plot and flock skills grey out. A ranged weapon keeps its damage and loses its reach. Click Hound again to step out, or Shed. Your hands are busy for 0.7s either way.

name: Strays
desc: A feral drone, up to {most}, biting for {dmg}. Past 4.5 paces they stop obeying and will hit you if you are closest.

name: Compost
desc: A corpse within 3 paces sinks. Your next plot skill deals {damage}% damage. With no body, nothing happens.

name: Wear the Hull
desc: Climb into the hull: slower, more armour, no dash. Hound skills grey out. The same reach collapse. Drops the hound if you were wearing it. Click Hull again to step out, or Shed.

name: The Bull
desc: One bull. It chooses its own target and hits for {dmg}. You cannot ride it.

name: Hedgerow
desc: A line that blocks movement for 4 seconds. Machines and you.

name: Shed
desc: Leave the form. Your hands are busy for 0.7s. Plot and flock work again.

name: Go Feral
desc: Passive. Drones past the leash deal +{damage}% damage and will not come back when you do.

name: Kill Frost
desc: Rust weather, 3.4 paces, for 8 seconds, {dmg} every half second. It ends the moment you enter a chassis.

name: Wear What You Killed
desc: Consume a machine that is not elite and wear it until you shed. You deal its damage type. Your flock despawns. Your weapons lose their range.

name: Rootbound
desc: Passive. Drones standing in your plots do not leash. Step out and the rule returns.

name: Salt the Earth
desc: Every plot you have placed bursts for {dmg} rust and is gone.

name: Too Big for the Door
desc: Passive. The hull cannot dash. Armour in the hull rises the longer you have worn it: +{armor} every 2 seconds, up to 8 times.

name: Slaughter Weight
desc: Each drone and the bull become a rust plot where they stand, {dmg} every half second. The flock is spent. You cannot do this from a chassis.

name: Look
desc: Mark one machine with Testimony. The stack grows while you can see them and you are not casting. No Record cost. A swing against a marked machine hits 7% harder for each point of Testimony, up to six.

name: The Sentence
desc: Spend Record, up to 25. Delay that machine's next attack by {sec}s at a full page. Less Record, a shorter delay. For 2.4s afterward you take 48% less, and an empty page does not punish you while that holds.

name: Margin
desc: Passive. Below half life the Record fills {faster}% faster.

name: Cross-reference
desc: Spend 20 Record. Copy that machine's last attack onto another machine you have Testimony on, at {copy}% of the blow.

name: Pull the Thread
desc: Spend most of the Record. One Impact hit, {dmg} for each point of Testimony, a little more when the page you spend is full, and your weapon is not consulted. No Testimony, no blow, and an empty page is not spent. 42% more for each level after the first, so the page keeps up with the machines.

name: Filed
desc: Passive. Testimony does not decay for {sec}s after the machine leaves the screen.

name: Correction
desc: Once per district. Spend the whole Record to restore the life you lost on the last hit, not a share of your maximum. An empty Record corrects nothing.

name: Redaction
desc: Spend 30 Record. For 2s machines can see you and cannot land a blow. They still path toward you. This is not stealth.

name: The Footnote
desc: Passive. The Record fills {faster}% faster. Maximum life is {lower}% lower.

name: On the Record
desc: Spend 25 Record. A machine with high Testimony takes {more}% more damage from everyone for 8s, including people with no points in this class.

name: Unnamed Source
desc: Spend 20 Record. Grant one ally, or your hireling, a single swing that deals Sound. Then it is gone. You never deal Sound.

name: Colophon
desc: Passive. {dr}% damage reduction. Record above 80: you take {less}% less on top of that. Record below 20: you take {more}% more. The meter is the defence.

name: Publish
desc: Consume all Testimony on screen. Each second you watched is {dmg} Impact. The Record drops to 0. 1% more for each level you have.

name: Named Party
desc: Passive. Allies deal +{damage}% damage to machines you have Testimony on. You do not.

name: Retraction
desc: Passive. If you would die with Record above 80, you drop to 1 life, the Record hits 0, and this cannot happen again for a long time. If you would die with an empty Record, you die.

name: Tick Tock Next Block
desc: Nine quick strikes of {dmg}. The tenth is a block and lands for {dmg2}. While the strikes are landing, and for 2.2s after the block, you take 22% less.

name: Have Fun Staying Poor
desc: Close range, {dmg}. It cannot miss, and it stuns for {sec}s.

name: Few Understand This
desc: Passive. +{damage}% damage for every machine still standing on screen, up to eight. Each one within six paces also cuts the damage you take by 6%, up to five.

name: Toxic Maximalism
desc: Aura. Stays on until you put on another. You attack {faster}% faster and hit {dmg} harder, and so does anybody fighting beside you. You run 50% faster.

name: Marked to Market
desc: Aura. Everything within {paces} paces of you takes +{bonus}% damage from every source.

name: Orange Pill
desc: Charge through the line, untouchable, for {dmg} to everything you pass. Whatever survives takes +30% damage for {sec}s.

name: Blessed Hashrate
desc: Hammers spiral out from you, {dmg} each, and they do not stop at the first thing they meet.

name: Proof of Work
desc: Aura. Everything near you takes {dmg} twice a second, for as long as you are near it.

name: Twenty-One Million
desc: Passive. +{damage}% damage, +{armor}% armour, and +{dr}% damage reduction. The difficulty cannot dilute what you hit for.

name: The Halving
desc: Sound. Each machine within 4.2 paces loses {loss}% of its current life. It will not be pushed below 35% of its maximum.

name: Running a Node
desc: Passive. While an aura is on, allies and your hireling gain +{damage}% damage. You gain half of that. With the aura off, nothing.

name: Cite Your Sources
desc: A volley of Sound, and only while an aura is on. Toxic Maximalism makes it fast and light. Marked to Market makes it slow and heavy. Proof of Work makes it tick. No aura, no volley.

name: Priced in Sound
desc: Passive. Damage you deal that is not Sound becomes Sound, and you keep {keep}% of it.

name: The Dip
desc: You ignore the next hit. You choose when. It does not fire itself when you fall.

name: Not Your Keys
desc: Passive. If a hireling or a rendered companion is alive, the hit that would kill you kills them instead, once a minute. Alone, it does nothing.
